copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解不熟悉的代码片段或模块。
copy.tagline_en: Deep-dive into any file or function in the codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand unfamiliar code.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会深入解释代码库中某个文件、函数或模块的作用、内部结构、外部连接和数据流。
howto.when: 当你需要理解代码库中某个具体组件（如文件、函数或模块）时，可以要求 Claude 进行详细解释。

say.text: 请解释 src/auth/login.ts 这个文件的作用。
say.note: Claude 会分析该文件在架构中的角色和内部结构。

say.text: 帮我理解 verifyToken 函数在 login.ts 中的逻辑。
say.note: Claude 会查找该函数并解释其输入、处理和输出。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will provide a thorough explanation of a specific file, function, or module in the codebase, covering its role, internal structure, external connections, and data flow.
howto.when_en: Trigger when you need a deep-dive explanation of a specific code component, such as a file, function, or module.

say_en.note: Claude will analyze the file's architectural role and internal structure.

say_en.text: Help me understand the verifyToken function in login.ts.
say_en.note: Claude will locate the function and explain its logic.
